# Harbour website relaunch: brief

Scope: a new marketing site for Harbour Freight Partners with a case study library and a quote request form.

Timeline: design sign-off in week two, build in weeks three to five, launch at the end of week six.

Budget: the fixed fee covers up to three rounds of design revisions. Extra rounds are billed hourly.

Owner on the client side is the head of marketing. Content is supplied by the client in a shared folder.
